title: The Phantom Fleet
logline: A desperate mayor hires a pilot to maintain a network of hologram buoys projecting a fake defense fleet to scare off pirates.

roles.description: Sweating profusely, constantly wiping their brow, wearing a cheap suit.
Suspicious, scarred, flying a patched-together interceptor.
A small, vulnerable mining settlement on an asteroid.
A fragile, automated projector disguised as a heavy cruiser.
A brutal gang of pirates that prey on defenseless colonies.

public_situation: The {role:frontier_colony} is miraculously protected by a massive, silent fleet of heavy cruisers that never move.
private_truth: The colony is completely defenseless. The "fleet" is just a network of cheap hologram buoys, and they are starting to malfunction.

beats.public_change: One of the heavy cruiser holograms starts flickering violently.

missions.reason: The mayor begs the pilot to buy and quietly deliver replacement projection lenses to fix the flickering buoy.
missions.private_fact: The pilot realizes the colony is completely unarmed.

beats.public_change: A pirate scout jumps into the system to investigate the flickering fleet.

missions.reason: The scout hires the pilot to run a deep thermal scan of the heavy cruisers to see if they are active.
missions.private_fact: The pilot must fake the scan results to hide the fact that the heavy cruisers produce zero heat.

beats.public_change: The pirate scout figures out the truth and prepares to broadcast it to the raider coalition.

missions.reason: The mayor pays the pilot everything the colony has to destroy the pirate scout before it can transmit.
missions.private_fact: The scout hails the pilot, offering them a massive cut of the colony's plunder if they let the transmission through.

player_choice.prompt: The scout is crippled but hasn't broadcast yet. They offer a share of the plunder to let them finish.

options.label: Destroy the scout and save the colony
Take the deal and doom the colony

resolutions.summary: The scout is destroyed. The secret holds, the pirates stay away, and the colony survives another day. The pilot is a quiet hero.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot protected a defenseless colony by maintaining their fake hologram defense fleet.

resolutions.summary: The scout transmits. The raider coalition arrives in force, slaughters the colonists, and plunders the town. The pilot gets a bloody payout.
The scout transmits the truth. The pirates swarm the colony, destroying it utterly. The mayor is killed, and the phantom fleet fades away.

loose_threads.detail: The hologram technology is highly classified theatre gear; the mayor must have stolen it from a navy depot.
The scout reveals the local corporate security patrol actually pays the pirates to attack unprotected colonies.

radio_hooks: {role:frontier_colony} reports zero pirate attacks for the third straight month.
Rumors of a massive stealth fleet protecting the frontier.

voice_direction.desperate_mayor: Nervous, high-pitched, tries to sound confident.
